labels.mapping: label[i] <-> cellula_MI_data_{i}.csv (first 2160 of 2400 labels); confirmed by the project owner

preprocessing: each continuous block (consecutive files) filtered as ONE stream; first/last trial of every block rejected
one robust (median-power) scalar per trial; inter-channel ratios preserved
cv_advice: session_id = recording (from Time gaps). Use GroupKFold on session_id, or contiguous (non-shuffled) KFold. Never shuffle trials across recordings.
caveats: no cue timing -> no ERD/ERS or baseline correction
CAR on 4 channels is rank-3: do not use X_clean_car for CSP
decodability_check: NO decodable signal with whole-trial CSP + LDA (labels are confirmed, so this is a signal/feature limitation)
